reason: The build fails at runtime due to missing core methods (run/step completion/visualize/save_results/validate) and absent infection/Rt modeling. With only two iterations left, a focused pass can restore end-to-end functionality, implement minimal epidemiology, compute required metrics, and fix the enforcement regression. This will yield a usable simulation and enable validation in the final iteration.

specific_areas: Iteration 26 (restore MVP runtime): Implement Simulation.run, complete Simulation.step (public + workplace visits, metrics finalization), add visualize, save_results, and validate stubs that execute.

Iteration 26: Implement infection dynamics (_simulate_infections) with simple SIR, mask-type inward/outward efficacy, ventilation/crowding modifiers, daily_new_infections, cumulative_infections, and Rt estimation.
Iteration 26: Add Person fields health_status, days_infected, mask_type {none, cloth, surgical, N95}, and ses; wire mask_type into adoption and transmission.

Iteration 26: Compute required metrics: adoption_rate_over_time, time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak and steady_state adoption, mask_use_by_location_type (public/work), cumulative_infections, Rt series, infection_reduction_pct placeholder, equity_gap_in_adoption (SES quintiles), enforcement_actions_count, stockout_frequency.
Iteration 26: Fix PolicyAuthority.adjust_enforcement to depend on active mandates (issue_mandates) and pass epidemic context; respect enforcement capacity per day.
Iteration 26: Ensure inventories/prices bounded and non-negative; clamp prices, prevent negative stock; update retailer pricing and supply-chain stockout logic.

Iteration 27 (validation and polish): Implement validate() criteria: adoption convergence, Rt < 1 under high adoption/high-efficacy scenario, inventory non-negativity, policy effect sign vs no-mandate baseline; run multiple seeds.

Iteration 27: Smooth Rt with 7-day window and parametric serial interval; refine parameters; add basic smoke tests (5-day run) and I/O checks; optional performance improvement by sampling visits instead of iterating all locations.

task_understanding.adjustments: Elevate the mandatory requirements (infection/Rt, equity gap, stockout frequency, validation criteria) as non-negotiable acceptance gates for the next iteration.

data_analysis.adjustments: Integrate EpidemicContext signals into mandate activation and perception updates; verify time series completeness each day (no missing keys, consistent lengths).

model_planning.adjustments: Adopt a two-step plan: 1) MVP end-to-end functionality and minimal epidemiology/metrics; 2) validation, smoothing, and parameter refinement. Defer non-essential features to the final pass.

code_generation.adjustments: Generate fully runnable code with all referenced methods implemented; avoid truncated sections or placeholder 'pass' paths; ensure method signatures used in main() exist and are tested.

code_verification.adjustments: Add pre-run assertions (inventory non-negativity, series length sync); run a 1–2 day smoke test before full 60-day runs; static checks for unused imports after save_results is added.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Execute a seed-fixed short run (5 days) to confirm basic dynamics, then the full run (60 days); track execution time and, if slow, enable visit sampling.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute and verify all required metrics; check ranges (0–1 for rates), monotonicity where applicable, and plausibility (Rt declines with high adoption).

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide concise, prioritized change lists with acceptance criteria; include minimal code diffs for the critical methods and a checklist to confirm runtime success.
